editor_note: Entry 10 is faithful: Qiskit's little-endian default, BitArray's `big` default, the caveat «بحسب ما إذا كانت primitive تغيّر هذا الإعداد أم لا», and the contrast between big-endian Sampler/Estimator and little-endian Executor («بينما يُرجع Executor نتائج little-endian») are all kept without inversion.

The seven rewritten headings are faithful and natural. The title uses imperatives (راقب وعاير وقِس الأداء) and the section headings use nouns (المراقبة، مراقبة المعاملات، المراقبة الشاملة، المعايرة، قياس الأداء), which matches the body's own wording, for example قياس الأداء اليومي.

None of the 7 rewritten entries misleads a learner. Entries 8, 10 and 11 are faithful and read naturally: "ZNE القائم على طي البوابات", "ترميزات الفرميون إلى كيوبت" and "دوائر ثابتة العمق" all match the English, and transpiler stays in English. Entry 7 has one small flaw. "توصيف الضجيج الكمومي القائم على العشوائية" uses "العشوائية" (randomness) where the source means "randomization". The phrase can also be read as noise that is randomness-based, when the English says the characterization is randomization-based. Entry 6 opens with the passive calque "تم بناء", which is stiff.

examples.source: a toolkit for randomization-based quantum noise characterization
examples.translation: مجموعة أدوات لتوصيف الضجيج الكمومي القائم على العشوائية
examples.suggested: مجموعة أدوات لتوصيف الضجيج الكمومي بأساليب قائمة على التعشية (randomization)
examples.why: 'العشوائية' means randomness, not randomization, and the trailing modifier can attach to 'الضجيج'. The phrase can then be read as 'randomness-based noise' rather than a randomization-based characterization method.

examples.source: New tools have been built on top of the directed execution model framework
examples.translation: تم بناء أدوات جديدة فوق إطار نموذج التنفيذ الموجّه
examples.suggested: بُنيت أدوات جديدة على إطار نموذج التنفيذ الموجّه
examples.why: 'تم + verbal noun' is a calque of the English passive, and 'فوق' is a literal rendering of 'on top of'. 'بُنيت ... على' is the natural Arabic technical phrasing.

editor_note: None of the six rewritten entries (5–10) changes the meaning, and the house-style names are kept in English (Circuit function, Application function, Qiskit Functions). Three small fixes would help. In entry 7, "سير العمل التي تتضمن" has a gender agreement error ("سير" is masculine singular). In entry 8, "الكثيفة بوابات SWAP" is a clipped calque of "SWAP-heavy" and reads awkwardly. In entry 9, "بشكل أصيل" for "natively" is translationese, since "أصيل" means authentic or genuine, not built-in.

examples.source: including workflows with mid-circuit measurements
examples.translation: بما في ذلك سير العمل التي تتضمن قياسات في منتصف الدائرة
examples.suggested: بما في ذلك مسارات العمل التي تتضمن قياسات في منتصف الدائرة
examples.why: "سير العمل" is masculine singular, so "التي" does not agree with it. Using the plural "مسارات العمل" fixes the agreement and matches the English plural.

examples.source: standard, SWAP-heavy transpilation methods
examples.translation: بطرق transpilation القياسية الكثيفة بوابات SWAP
examples.suggested: بطرق transpilation القياسية التي تعتمد بكثافة على بوابات SWAP
examples.why: "الكثيفة بوابات SWAP" copies the English compound adjective word for word and is not a natural Arabic construction.

examples.source: enforcing one-hot and set-packing constraints natively through XY-mixers
examples.translation: وتفرض قيود one-hot وset-packing بشكل أصيل عبر XY-mixers
examples.suggested: وتفرض قيود one-hot وset-packing مباشرةً ضمن بنية الدائرة عبر XY-mixers
examples.why: "أصيل" means authentic or genuine, so it does not carry the technical sense of "natively" (built into the mechanism itself).

editor_note: Entry 5 is faithful and reads naturally. Both senses of "migrating" are kept apart (تنتقل إلى Sampler وEstimator الجديدين من جهة العميل and تُرحّل دفاتر قديمة), "IBM-verified" is rendered as موثّقة من IBM, and the closing future promise is kept intact as سنضيف مزيدًا من المهارات.

Entry 129 is faithful and would not mislead a learner. The client-side capture of design intents, the move of costly circuit-variant generation to the server, Samplomatic choosing where Pauli-twirling and noise injection apply, and Executor carrying out the directives in Qiskit Runtime all come through, and أولية Executor matches how primitive is rendered elsewhere in the file (entries 45, 61). Two minor slips: 'circuit' is rendered دارة here, while most of the page uses دائرة (entries 17, 21, 55-57, 59), so the split continues. Also, 'the exact layers in your circuits' became the singular الطبقات الدقيقة في دارتك, and الدقيقة can be misread as 'fine/tiny layers' rather than 'exactly the layers'.

examples.source: to define the exact layers in your circuits
examples.translation: لتحديد الطبقات الدقيقة في دارتك
examples.suggested: لتحديد الطبقات بعينها في دوائرك
examples.why: 'circuits' is plural in English but singular دارتك here, and the page mostly uses دائرة, not دارة. الدقيقة can also be read as 'fine/precise layers' rather than 'exactly which layers'.

examples.source: shifting the costly generation of circuit variants to the server side ... randomized circuit variants
examples.translation: ونقل عملية توليد متغيرات الدارة المكلفة ... متغيرات الدارة العشوائية
examples.suggested: ونقل عملية توليد متغيرات الدائرة المكلفة ... متغيرات الدائرة العشوائية
examples.why: Using دائرة would match the dominant rendering in the file. The meaning is unaffected.

editor_note: I checked all 10 rewritten entries against the English and found no meaning drift. The directed execution model (نموذج التنفيذ الموجّه), the Samplomatic and Executor composition, the low-friction upgrade that only needs import changes, and the IBM-verified skills repository all match the source. There are three small style issues. In entry 8, «فحص طريقة تنفيذ كل طريقة» uses طريقة twice in a row. In entry 11, «تكديس طرق» is a literal calque of "stacking"; «الجمع بين طرق» reads more naturally. In entry 10, «موثّقة من IBM» can also read as "documented by IBM" rather than "IBM-verified"; «معتمدة من IBM» is unambiguous.

examples.source: inspect exactly how each error mitigation method is implemented
examples.translation: فحص طريقة تنفيذ كل طريقة لتخفيف الأخطاء بدقة
examples.suggested: فحص كيفية تنفيذ كل أسلوب من أساليب تخفيف الأخطاء بدقة
examples.why: طريقة appears twice in a row: once meaning "how" and once meaning "method". It reads awkwardly.

examples.source: an example of stacking error detection and mitigation methods
examples.translation: مثال لتكديس طرق اكتشاف الأخطاء وتخفيفها
examples.suggested: مثال على الجمع بين طرق اكتشاف الأخطاء وتخفيفها
examples.why: «تكديس» is a literal calque of "stacking". A native technical writer would say «الجمع بين» or «دمج».

examples.source: official, IBM-verified agent skills
examples.translation: مهارات وكلاء رسمية وموثّقة من IBM
examples.suggested: مهارات وكلاء رسمية ومعتمدة من IBM
examples.why: «موثّقة» can also mean "documented". «معتمدة» clearly means verified or endorsed.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, including the Heron conditional versus Nighthawk unconditional reset caveat (تعتمد إعادة الضبط على نتيجة القياس / غير مشروطة), and terms are used consistently (القيم المرصودة, فقدان الترابط (decoherence), الاختيار اللاحق, تضمين for "modulates" in the AC TLS entry).

Entry 24 is faithful and reads naturally. It renders "guides and API reference documentation" as "وثائق [الأدلة] و[مرجع API]" and "Feel free to submit feedback" as "لا تتردّد في تقديم ملاحظاتك" in the informal register, and every link is intact.

None of the 10 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The option names, the Estimator/Sampler conditions and the PEA-requires-ZNE caveat in [42] all match the English. The problems are terms that clash with the rest of the page. Entry [11] renders dynamical decoupling as the garbled "فصل الانفصال الديناميكي" ("separating the separation") and then "الفصل الديناميكي", while the heading [6] and body [7]-[9] use "فك الاقتران الديناميكي". Entry [19] renders Pauli twirling as "تفتيل Pauli" / "التفتيل", where the rest of the page uses "تلوية باولي" / "التلوية". Entry [42] says "الضجيج" for noise, but the rest of the page uses "الضوضاء".

examples.source: You can enable dynamical decoupling the following ways: ... Dynamical decoupling transpiler pass ... The dynamical decoupling option
examples.translation: يمكنك تفعيل فصل الانفصال الديناميكي (dynamical decoupling) بالطرق التالية: ... تمريرة المحوّل للفصل الديناميكي ... خيار الفصل الديناميكي
examples.suggested: يمكنك تفعيل فك الاقتران الديناميكي بالطرق التالية: ... تمريرة المحوّل لفك الاقتران الديناميكي ... خيار فك الاقتران الديناميكي
examples.why: 'فصل الانفصال' is a garbled doubling, and it differs from the page's own term 'فك الاقتران الديناميكي' used in [6]-[9]. Only the English in parentheses tells the reader it is the same technique.

examples.source: You can enable Pauli twirling the following ways: ... Pauli twirling custom pass ... The twirling options
examples.translation: يمكنك تفعيل تفتيل Pauli (Pauli twirling) ... تمريرة مخصصة لتفتيل Pauli ... خيارات التفتيل
examples.suggested: يمكنك تفعيل تلوية باولي بالطرق التالية: ... تمريرة مخصصة لتلوية باولي ... خيارات التلوية
examples.why: The rest of the page ([12]-[17], [21]-[24]) uses 'تلوية باولي' / 'التلوية' / 'الملوَّاة'. This entry switches to 'تفتيل' and Latin 'Pauli'.

examples.source: Because PEA is a ZNE noise amplification technique
examples.translation: بما أن PEA تقنية لتضخيم الضجيج في ZNE
examples.suggested: بما أن PEA تقنية لتضخيم الضوضاء في ZNE
examples.why: Everywhere else the page uses 'الضوضاء' for noise, including 'تضخيم الضوضاء' in [30] and [40].

editor_note: None of the 22 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The PEA prerequisite "(يجب تفعيل ZNE أيضًا)" and the client-side v0.50.0 caveat are both kept intact. Entry 49 has three problems. It uses "الضجيج" for noise, but the rest of the page uses "الضوضاء" ("إدارة الضوضاء", entries 7 and 41). It uses "الدوائر" for circuits, but the page elsewhere uses "الدارات" (entries 34, 35, 39). And the phrase "مهمة تعلّم الضجيج منفصلة مطلوبة" has broken word order: the adjective "منفصلة" is attached to the end of a construct phrase (iḍāfa), so the sentence reads as a calque. The repeated label "خيارات جديرة بالملاحظة" (entries 11, 16, 20, 24, 30) is a stiff literal rendering of "Notable options". It is defensible, but "أبرز الخيارات" is the more natural form.

examples.source: a separate noise-learning job is required to use PEA and PEC
examples.translation: فإن مهمة تعلّم الضجيج منفصلة مطلوبة لاستخدام PEA وPEC
examples.suggested: فيلزم تشغيل مهمة منفصلة لتعلّم الضوضاء لاستخدام PEA وPEC
examples.why: Noise is rendered as الضجيج only here; the rest of the file uses الضوضاء. The adjective منفصلة also sits awkwardly after the construct phrase.

examples.source: Not all options work together on all types of circuits.
examples.translation: لا تعمل كل الخيارات معًا على كل أنواع الدوائر.
examples.suggested: لا تعمل كل الخيارات معًا على كل أنواع الدارات.
examples.why: Elsewhere the page renders circuit as دارة/دارات (entries 34, 35, 39), so this is a within-file inconsistency.

examples.source: **Notable options**: `sequence_type`
examples.translation: **خيارات جديرة بالملاحظة**: `sequence_type`
examples.suggested: **أبرز الخيارات**: `sequence_type`
examples.why: A literal calque of 'notable', repeated across entries 11/16/20/24/30. A native technical writer would write أبرز الخيارات.

editor_note: Entry 43 keeps its meaning (the latest qiskit-ibm-runtime version is documented, and older versions are in the API reference), but its opening is ungrammatical. "يوثّق الصفحة التالية" uses a masculine verb with the feminine noun الصفحة, so it should be "توثّق". It also turns "the following information" into "the following page" (الصفحة التالية), which could suggest a separate page when the options are listed further down this same page. Neither problem would mislead a learner, but a native editor would fix both.

examples.source: The following information documents options from the latest version of `qiskit-ibm-runtime`.
examples.translation: يوثّق الصفحة التالية الخيارات من أحدث إصدار من `qiskit-ibm-runtime`.
examples.suggested: توثّق المعلومات التالية الخيارات المتاحة في أحدث إصدار من `qiskit-ibm-runtime`.
examples.why: The masculine verb يوثّق does not agree with the feminine subject الصفحة, which is a plain grammar error. Also, 'information' became 'page' (الصفحة), which can suggest a separate next page when the content is lower on this one.

editor_note: Entry 54 is faithful and natural: all five recommendations are kept, with "directed execution model" as نموذج التنفيذ الموجَّه (the same term used in the rest of the file), "broadcasting" as البث and the tutorial title as إلغاء الأخطاء الاحتمالي مع مخاريط الضوء المظللة, which matches PEC's rendering in entry 26.

The four rewritten entries (32, 34-36) keep the English meaning. Shapes (28, 10, 1024, 3) and (28, 10, 1, 3), the one-shot reason for the bit-flip array, little-endian order and the least-significant bit (البت الأقل أهمية) all match the source. Twirling (التدوير) and shots (لقطة/لقطات) are used the same way as in the rest of the page. The one thing to change is in entries 32 and 36: 'right-most axis' becomes 'المحور الأيمن' ('the right axis'), which is weaker for a 3- or 4-axis array, and 'runs over' becomes the calque 'يمتد على'. A native editor would write 'المحور الأخير (أقصى اليمين)' with 'يقابل' or 'يُفهرِس'.

examples.source: The right-most axis of `result_0` runs over classical bits in little-endian order.
examples.translation: يمتد المحور الأيمن في `result_0` على البتات الكلاسيكية بترتيب little-endian.
examples.suggested: يقابل المحورُ الأخير (أقصى اليمين) في `result_0` البتاتِ الكلاسيكية بترتيب little-endian.
examples.why: 'المحور الأيمن' does not mark this as the last of several axes the way 'right-most' does, and 'يمتد على' is a word-for-word copy of 'runs over'. The same fix applies to entry 36 (result_1).

editor_note: Entry 11 is faithful and natural. "يمكن لـ Executor معالجة المعلومات المُشفَّرة في samplexes فقط" keeps the restriction "only" in the right place. It uses المُشفَّرة for "encoded", as entry 6 does, and "لفهم القيود" renders "to understand restrictions".

Entries 12 and 15 keep the meaning of the English. Every comparison is intact, including HI-VQE's "على التوالي" (respectively) pairing with "بمراتب من الحجم" (by orders of magnitude), and nothing would mislead a learner. A native editor would still change some wording. "Variational" is rendered as "المتغيرة" (that is, variable or changing) in both "الخوارزميات الكمومية المتغيرة" and "تدريب المعاملات المتغيرة", where "التغايرية" is the standard term. "Classical solvers" became "الحلول الكلاسيكية" (classical solutions), and "adaptation of VQE" became the reflexive "تكيُّف" instead of "تكييف". Transpilation is left as English "transpilation" in these rows, but the page's earlier table uses "التحويل (Transpilation)".

examples.source: without variational parameter training
examples.translation: دون تدريب المعاملات المتغيرة
examples.suggested: دون تدريب المعاملات التغايرية
examples.why: 'المتغيرة' means variable/changing, not variational. The same rendering appears in entry 12 as 'الخوارزميات الكمومية المتغيرة'. A learner can still recognize it, but it is not the conventional term.

examples.source: runtime advantage over classical solvers (CPLEX, simulated annealing, and tabu search)
examples.translation: ميزة وقت تشغيل على الحلول الكلاسيكية (CPLEX والتلدين المحاكى والبحث التابو)
examples.suggested: ميزة في وقت التشغيل مقارنةً بأدوات الحل الكلاسيكية (CPLEX والتلدين المحاكى وبحث تابو)
examples.why: Solvers are tools, not solutions. The listed items are algorithms and solvers.

examples.source: a highly specialized adaptation of the VQE quantum algorithm
examples.translation: تكيُّف متخصَّص للغاية لخوارزمية VQE
examples.suggested: تكييف متخصص للغاية لخوارزمية VQE
examples.why: 'تكيُّف' is the reflexive (self-adapting). The transitive 'تكييف' means the adaptation someone made.

examples.source: Combines optimized transpilation
examples.translation: يجمع بين transpilation المحسّن
examples.suggested: يجمع بين التحويل (transpilation) المحسَّن
examples.why: Entry 7 renders this as 'التحويل (Transpilation)'. Here the bare English word sits inside an Arabic sentence, so the page is inconsistent.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries (25 and 27) keep the English meaning. Entry 25 correctly says the template circuit is structurally equivalent to the original, that only its single-qubit gates become parameterized (بوابات ذات معاملات), and that the samplex encodes what is needed for randomized parameters. Annotation stays تعليقات, consistent with entries 7 and 22. The one thing to change is "the prescribed annotations", rendered as التعليقات المُوصوفة: موصوفة mostly reads as "described" (or a medical prescription), so المحددة fits better. Entry 27 (وثائق API في Samplomatic ... ووسائطه) is clean.

examples.source: in order to implement the prescribed annotations (gate and measurement twirling, in this example)
examples.translation: لتطبيق التعليقات المُوصوفة (تفتيل البوابات والقياسات في هذا المثال)
examples.suggested: لتطبيق التعليقات المحددة (تفتيل البوابات والقياسات في هذا المثال)
examples.why: موصوفة mostly means 'described' (or a medical prescription), which is an awkward fit for annotations the user specified. المحددة is the natural technical wording. It does not mislead.

editor_note: The rewritten entries are faithful. Nothing in them would mislead: IBM's responsibilities, the recommended region switch with its two caveats, and the wait-for-recovery path all match the English. The main slip is terminology. The new entries render "region" as منطقة (التبديل إلى منطقة بديلة, المنطقة المتأثرة, منطقة مختلفة), but the unchanged entry 8 uses إقليم for region and منطقة توافر / منطقة for "zone". The page leans on the region-vs-zone contrast, so the new entries should use إقليم (إقليم بديل, الإقليم المتأثر), which also matches the adjective إقليمي that they already use. Separately, "workload" in entry 22 is calqued as حمل عملك, where عبء العمل is the usual term.

examples.source: **Switch to an alternate region (recommended)**
examples.translation: **التبديل إلى منطقة بديلة (موصى به)**
examples.suggested: **التبديل إلى إقليم بديل (موصى به)**
examples.why: Entry 8 (unchanged) uses إقليم for region and منطقة توافر for zone. Using منطقة for region in entries 10, 17, 21-27 blurs the region/zone distinction the page relies on.

examples.source: ...only available in the affected region.
examples.translation: ...لا تتوفر إلا في المنطقة المتأثرة.
examples.suggested: ...لا تتوفر إلا في الإقليم المتأثر.
examples.why: Same region→منطقة inconsistency with entry 8. Zones are also called منطقة (entry 9), so the reader could take this to mean a zone.

examples.source: If your workload allows it, provision a new ... instance
examples.translation: إذا كان حمل عملك يسمح بذلك، وفّر [نسخة](/guides/instances) جديدة
examples.suggested: إذا كان عبء العمل لديك يسمح بذلك، أنشئ [نسخة](/guides/instances) جديدة
examples.why: حمل عملك is a literal calque of 'workload'. The standard term is عبء العمل. Also, وفّر here is ambiguous because it can mean 'save'.

editor_note: All 13 rewritten entries keep the English meaning: the legacy server-side vs. client-side contrast (entries 24, 40, 41), the v0.50.0 version notes and the roughly 32-qubit and memory-overhead caveat all come through intact, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The issues are wording only. Entries 42 and 44 say 'noise' as الضجيج/الضجيجية, while the rest of the page uses الضوضاء and مع الضوضاء. Entry 23 names Sampler and Estimator twice ('Sampler وEstimator من جهة العميل (`Sampler` و`Estimator`، ...)'). Entry 42 also has a small grammar slip: '32 كيوبت' should be '32 كيوبتًا'.

examples.source: Local noisy simulation cost grows exponentially with qubit count
examples.translation: تنمو تكلفة المحاكاة المحلية الضجيجية أُسّيًا مع عدد الكيوبتات
examples.suggested: تنمو تكلفة المحاكاة المحلية مع الضوضاء أُسّيًا مع عدد الكيوبتات، ولا تستطيع معظم الحواسب المحمولة محاكاة أكثر من نحو 32 كيوبتًا
examples.why: The rest of the page says noise as الضوضاء (entries 10, 15, 30–33). Switching to الضجيج only in the new entries makes the term inconsistent. '32 كيوبت' also needs the accusative tamyiz: كيوبتًا.

examples.source: A noiseless simulator.
examples.translation: محاكٍ خالٍ من الضجيج.
examples.suggested: محاكٍ خالٍ من الضوضاء.
examples.why: Use the same noise term as the rest of the file (الضوضاء).

examples.source: With the client-side `Sampler` and `Estimator` (introduced in `qiskit-ibm-runtime` v0.50.0)
examples.translation: ومع Sampler وEstimator من جهة العميل (`Sampler` و`Estimator`، اللذين قُدِّما في `qiskit-ibm-runtime` v0.50.0)
examples.suggested: ومع `Sampler` و`Estimator` من جهة العميل (اللذين قُدِّما في `qiskit-ibm-runtime` v0.50.0)
examples.why: The names appear twice, once as plain text and once in code formatting, which reads clumsily. Entry 40 already shows the clean form.

editor_note: Entry 64 is accurate: the Operator comparison, the measurement_flips caveat and the Statevector alternative all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The term 'measurement twirling' is a problem, though. This entry renders it as 'تبريم القياس', while the rest of the file uses 'تفتيل' consistently (entry 93 has 'تفتيل القياس' and entry 94 has 'ألغِ التفتيل'), so the same idea gets a second name. Also, 'each randomization' becomes 'كل عملية عشوائية' ('each random operation'), which drops the link to entry 63's 'عمليات العشوائية (randomizations)'.

examples.source: that undo measurement twirling
examples.translation: التي تُلغي تبريم القياس (measurement twirling)
examples.suggested: التي تُلغي تفتيل القياس (measurement twirling)
examples.why: Everywhere else the file renders twirling as تفتيل (entries 17, 32, 93, 94). Using تبريم only here gives the same concept two names within one page.

examples.source: verify that each randomization is logically equivalent to the original circuit
examples.translation: التحقق من أن كل عملية عشوائية مكافئة منطقيًا للدائرة الأصلية

editor_note: Entries 21 and 27 say what the English says. "consider using" becomes "ففكّر في استخدام", "annotated boxes" becomes "صناديق موسومة", and "لتنفيذ الدارات" matches the wording of entries 19 and 26 that sit beside them.

Entry 65 is faithful and natural, and its "تصريف دارة" for "transpile a circuit" matches the file's المُصرِّف. Entry 46 has two terminology slips. First, "Non-unitary instructions" became "تعليمات غير أحادية". It sits in the same table as "بوابات أحادية الكيوبت" (single-qubit gates), so a reader can take it as "non-single", and it doesn't match entry 40, which renders unitary as "الواحدية (unitary)". Second, "classical feedforward" became "تغذية راجعة كلاسيكية", which means classical feedback, not feedforward ("تغذية أمامية"). Neither slip changes the table's facts, so the verdict is MINOR_ISSUES, not FAIL.

editor_note: Entry 18 is faithful and reads naturally: the client-side/server-side split (الأدوات من جانب العميل / من جانب الخادم), the "python 3.11+" requirement and the custom-infrastructure pointer (بنية تحتية مخصصة) all carry over exactly.

Entry 26 keeps the English meaning, and every link target and list item is still there. The dual دليلَي [المساهم] و[المشرف] for "contributor and maintainer guides" reads naturally. One phrase is a calque: "اتفاقيات ترخيص PDF" builds an idafa chain that can be read as "agreements for licensing PDF". A native editor would mark the file format explicitly with "اتفاقيات الترخيص بصيغة PDF". It does not mislead, so this is only a naturalness fix.

editor_note: None of the six rewritten entries changes the meaning. The simulator-default claims, the "only if you want real hardware" condition and the FakeBackends/Settings details in entries 13 and 17 all match the English. The problem is mixed terminology. Entries 5 and 6 use "الحوسبة الكمّية" and "دارة كمّية", while entries 13, 14 and 17 (and the rest of the page) use "كمومي/كمومية" and "دائرة". So the hero CTA "شغّل أول دارة كمّية لك" does not match the card title "أول دائرة كمومية لك" next to it. Make entries 5 and 6 use the page's usual "كمومية" and "دائرة".

editor_note: Entry 42 is faithful and reads naturally. It keeps the antisymmetry-under-exchange caveat (التناظر المضاد عند التبادل), the requirement for a bosonic operator (عامل بوزوني), and the reason for using Pauli operators (إيرميتية وأحادية في آنٍ واحد). It also uses the same عوامل/تعيين/جوردان-ويغنر terms as the rest of the page.

The page reads as if several translators worked on it separately, and core terms change from section to section. Post-selection is both الاختيار اللاحق and الانتقاء اللاحق. Stabilizer codes is شفرات المثبّتات, الشيفرات المثبِّتة and أكواد. Coherent Pauli checks is both فحوصات Pauli المترابطة and فحوص باولي المتماسكة. Pauli and Clifford switch between Latin and Arabic script, circuit between الدائرة and الدارة, noise between الضجيج and الضوضاء, and fault-tolerant between متحمّل للأعطال and المقاوم للأخطاء. "Conjugate/conjugation" is rendered as نقارن ("we compare", [177]) and as الاقتران, the same word the page uses for check "couplings" ([226]-[227]). The formulas still make the meaning recoverable. There are also a few small meaning slips. In [142] "even though the ratio above does not [hold in general]" became "even if the ratio above does not support it". In [289] "lower per-shot accuracy is acceptable" lost the "is acceptable" condition. In [6] and [306] "active correction" became بشكل فعّال / الفعّال ("effective"). None of these reverses a core claim.

examples.source: The conclusion that the syndrome-extraction circuit is itself noisy still holds, even though the ratio above does not.
examples.translation: ويبقى الاستنتاج القائل إن دائرة استخراج المتلازمة نفسها مصدر للضوضاء صحيحًا، حتى لو لم تدعمه النسبة أعلاه.
examples.suggested: ويبقى الاستنتاج القائل إن دائرة استخراج المتلازمة نفسها مصدر للضوضاء صحيحًا، حتى وإن كانت النسبة أعلاه لا تنطبق عمومًا.
examples.why: The English says the extreme gate-count ratio does not generalize. The Arabic says the ratio fails to support the noise conclusion, which is a different claim.

examples.source: We then conjugate $R$ through the payload to obtain $L$. ... returns the Heisenberg-picture conjugate $U^\dagger R\, U$
examples.translation: ثم نقارن $R$ عبر الحمولة للحصول على $L$. تعيد ... مباشرة المقارن في صورة هايزنبرغ

editor_note: I found no semantic drift. The negations, numbers, the TREX/ZNE/PEC compatibility claims and the worked examples (54.5%/45.5%, 1.1875/−0.0625, the 6- and 30-qubit PEC results) all match the English. The page reads as if it was translated in three chunks with different glossaries, so core terms change partway through. twirling is الالتفاف العشوائي, then التدوير, then plain English "twirling". ZNE is الاستقراء إلى ضوضاء صفرية, then الاستكمال الخارجي. expectation value switches between القيمة المتوقعة and قيمة التوقّع, circuit between دائرة and دارة, assignment matrix between مصفوفة الإسناد and مصفوفة التعيين, unitary between وحدوية and أحادية, and quasi-probability takes four forms. One case comes close to confusing the reader: المعايرة means calibration in the M3/TREX sections, but in the PEC derivation it stands for normalization, and calibration becomes الضبط. There are also small grammar and typo slips, such as تُزدحم بها and the Persian kaf in مارکوفيًا.

examples.source: Normalization: To ensure that this operation does not change the scale of the observable...
examples.translation: المعايرة (Normalization): لضمان ألا تغيّر هذه العملية مقياس الكمية المرصودة...
examples.suggested: التسوية (Normalization): ... (keep المعايرة for calibration, as in the M3/TREX sections)
examples.why: Earlier in the file المعايرة means calibration, and here it labels normalization while calibration becomes الضبط in [324]. Swapping labels between two neighbouring conditions risks blurring the two concepts.

examples.source: to avoid conflating effects of twirling with the effect of ZNE

examples.suggested: لتجنب خلط تأثيرات الالتفاف العشوائي بتأثير ZNE
examples.why: twirling is الالتفاف العشوائي in the TREX section, التدوير here, and left in English from [265] on (Pauli twirling). Three renderings of one concept in one file.

examples.source: Zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE)
examples.translation: الاستكمال الخارجي إلى ضوضاء صفرية (ZNE)
examples.suggested: الاستقراء إلى ضوضاء صفرية (ZNE)
examples.why: The overview ([11]) and the video description introduce ZNE as الاستقراء إلى ضوضاء صفرية, but its own section switches to الاستكمال الخارجي. expectation value also flips between القيمة المتوقعة and قيمة التوقّع in the same span.

editor_note: The rewritten entries 6 and 7 say exactly what the English says. Nothing is added or dropped, and the video's "how they work" and "how they relate to other methods" are kept. The problem is terminology: both entries render "error suppression" as كبت الأخطاء, while the rest of the page uses قمع الأخطاء throughout (the title [1], the heading [4], the definition [5], and [110], [130], [169]). Learners will still recognise the concept, but they get two terms for it within a few lines, so entries 6 and 7 should be changed to قمع الأخطاء.

editor_note: All four rewritten link titles read naturally and match the English: "الكيمياء الكمية باستخدام VQE", "استخدام حاسوب كمي اليوم", and "Qiskit في الصف الدراسي - علوم الحاسوب / الميكانيكا الكمية", with VQE and Qiskit kept in English and the link paths left unchanged.

The two rewritten link titles are faithful and natural: "Qiskit في الصف الدراسي - علوم الحاسوب" and "... - الميكانيكا الكمية" keep Qiskit in English, use the standard Arabic terms for the two fields, and leave the URLs unchanged.

The meaning is faithful throughout. Conditions, bounds, the monotonicity claims and the ⁴⁸Cr caveats all survive. The page was clearly translated in two passes, and core terms switch around entry [128]. Before that point the page uses تهيج / تقطير / هاملتونيان / تهيئات / نويات / دائرة / كمي / تبايني / pooled SQD. From there on it uses إثارة / قطرنة / هاميلتوني / إعدادات / نوكليونات / دارة / كمومي / تغايري / SQD المجمَّع. Among the switched terms, "configuration" rendered as إعدادات ("settings") is the weakest choice; it should be تهيئات, as earlier in the page. There are also small slips: "twirling" is rendered as التشويش in [99], التبايينية is a typo in [112], and تردّ is used for "reject" in [105].

examples.suggested: يتم تفعيل الـ twirling للبوابات والقياسات

examples.suggested: الحدود التباينية

editor_note: I found no semantic drift. The negations and caveats come through intact, including the diagonal-filter caveat in [58] and the advice to skip pruning in [91]. The file switches terms partway through, around [67]. Circuit is دارة up to there and دائرة after it. Hamiltonian is الهاميلتوني early and الهاملتوني later. Ground state is الحالة الأرضية early but الحالة الأساسية in [82]-[83]. Configurations are الإعدادات ("settings") in [53]/[58] and التكوينات from [84] on. The most confusing slip is in [67]: the operators $h_i$ are called معاملات/معامل, the word this file uses for the coefficients $c_i$. That blurs the operator/coefficient split that [19] sets up. The same entry also has a gender-agreement error, "يقوم تمريرة".

editor_note: Entry 18 is faithful: the condition and the step references (الخطوة 4 / الخطوة 5) match the English, the caveat «إلى أن تفعل ذلك، لا تحفظ الخلية أي شيء» is kept, and the overwrite guarantee «لن يستبدل أبدًا حسابًا حفظته سابقًا» keeps the same meaning and strength.

None of the three rewritten entries would mislead a learner. Entry 23 is faithful and matches the QAOA wording in entry 20 (التحسين التقريبي الكمومي). Entry 38 is inconsistent with the rest of the page: it spells Ising in Arabic script (إيزينغ) and renders "transverse-field" as المجال المستعرض, while entries 55, 59, 61 and 62 keep "Ising" in Latin script and entry 59 uses ذو المجال العرضي for the same transverse-field Ising model. Entry 37 translates "tomography" as التصوير alone, dropping المقطعي; the English gloss in parentheses keeps the meaning recoverable, but the usual Arabic term is التصوير المقطعي الظلي.

examples.suggested: محاكاة التطور الزمني لنموذج Ising ذي المجال العرضي
examples.why: Elsewhere on the page Ising stays in Latin script (entries 55, 59, 61, 62), and entry 59 renders the same model's 'transverse-field' as المجال العرضي. Two different renderings of one model on one index page look like two different models.

examples.suggested: التصوير المقطعي الظلي (Shadow tomography) لحالة Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger

editor_note: The rewritten Fortran section keeps the meaning of the English throughout: the variational-bound argument, the 640-determinant check, the per-step versus pooled restriction and the comparison table all match. The problems are terminology and consistency. 'Variational upper bound' is حد أعلى تبايني in entries 173 and 181 but حد أعلى تغايري in 193, where تغايري reads as 'covariant'. Hamiltonian appears in three forms (هاميلتونيان, الهاملتوني, and the untranslated Hamiltonian in 181/184), and subspace splits between الفضاء الجزئي and فضاء فرعي. Entry 181 has calques: 'ground state' becomes حالة الأرض, while 204 uses the correct الحالة الأساسية, and 'basis states' becomes الحالات الأساسية, which readers can take for 'ground states'. 'Core' is rendered as نواة (nucleus) in 180 and 226, and 'rescaling' as إعادة قياس ('re-measuring') in 226.

examples.source: to get a variational upper bound
examples.translation: للحصول على حد أعلى تغايري
examples.suggested: للحصول على حد أعلى تبايني
examples.why: Entries 173 and 181 use تبايني. Here تغايري means covariant, which is the wrong concept and inconsistent with the rest of the file.

examples.source: A quantum circuit is used only to *propose* which basis states matter ... upper bound on the true ground-state energy

examples.suggested: لاقتراح* حالات الأساس المهمة ... على طاقة الحالة الأساسية الحقيقية
examples.why: حالة الأرض is a literal calque of 'ground state' (204 correctly uses الحالة الأساسية). الحالات الأساسية for 'basis states' then reads as 'ground states'.

examples.translation: فوق *نواة* خاملة
examples.suggested: فوق *لُبّ* خامل
examples.why: نواة is already used for 'nucleus' in the same sentence, so 'core' blurs into the nucleus itself. Entry 226 repeats this with طاقة النواة for 'core energy'.

examples.translation: Hamiltonian هو حد أحادي الجسيم زائد تفاعل ثنائي الجسيم
examples.suggested: الهاميلتونيان هو حد أحادي الجسيم زائد تفاعل ثنائي الجسيم

examples.suggested: مع إعادة تحجيم عناصر مصفوفة الجسمين ... وتُسقط إعادة التحجيم
examples.why: إعادة قياس suggests re-measuring, not rescaling (198 uses تحجيم). There is also a gender slip in يُرجَّح أن تقع تردد.

editor_note: None of the three rewritten entries (18, 65, 71) would mislead a learner. Two small slips remain. In entry 65, "annotated boxes" became "صناديق موضّحة" ("clarified/illustrated boxes"), which loses the sense of boxes that carry annotations; elsewhere the page calls these annotations تعليقات or توصيفات, so "صناديق ذات توصيفات" or "صناديق مُعلَّمة" would fit better. Also, entry 65 renders circuit as "الدائرة" while entry 71 uses "الدارات", repeating the دائرة/دارة split found across the page.

examples.source: which places the circuit instructions into annotated boxes
examples.translation: الذي يضع تعليمات الدائرة في صناديق موضّحة
examples.suggested: الذي يضع تعليمات الدائرة في صناديق ذات توصيفات
examples.why: موضّحة means 'clarified/illustrated', not 'annotated'. The page renders Box/InjectNoise annotations as توصيفات or تعليقات, so this hides the link to those annotations.

examples.source: when boxing circuits and finding unique instructions
examples.translation: عند وضع الدارات في صناديق وإيجاد التعليمات الفريدة
examples.suggested: عند وضع الدوائر في صناديق وإيجاد التعليمات الفريدة
examples.why: Entries 65 and 71 were rewritten together, yet 65 uses دائرة for circuit and 71 uses دارة. This repeats the inconsistency found across the page; دائرة is the majority form.

editor_note: Entry 126 is faithful and reads naturally: canonical form is rendered as الشكل القانوني, the same term as the heading in entry 124, "حدود باولي" matches entries 125 and 135, and `Executor` and the Samplomatic link are kept intact.

The meaning is faithful all the way through. The caveats that QAOA is no better than uniform random sampling at 40 assets ([21], [55]) and that the 8-asset run is effectively a brute-force check ([43]) are kept intact. Two terms switch form within the file. "Pareto front" is "جبهة Pareto" everywhere except [42], which has "جبهة باريتو". "post-selection" is "الانتقاء اللاحق" in [10] and [36] but "الاختيار اللاحق" in [42]. In the QAP admonition [50], "gate budget" became "الميزان نفسه من البوابات" ("balance/scale"), which is the wrong word. It should be "ميزانية البوابات".

examples.source: and extract the **Pareto front**
examples.translation: ثم نستخرج **جبهة باريتو**
examples.suggested: ثم نستخرج **جبهة Pareto**
examples.why: Every other entry keeps Pareto in Latin script. This is the only place it is transliterated.

examples.source: exactly $K$ assets from the post-selection step
examples.translation: من خطوة الاختيار اللاحق
examples.suggested: من خطوة الانتقاء اللاحق
examples.why: [36] defines post-selection as الانتقاء اللاحق, so here the learner gets a different term for the same step.

examples.source: so the same gate budget buys a shallower, more hardware-friendly circuit
examples.translation: فيشتري الميزان نفسه من البوابات دائرة أقل عمقًا
examples.suggested: فتشتري ميزانية البوابات نفسها دائرة أقل عمقًا وأكثر ملاءمة للعتاد
examples.why: الميزان means a scale or balance, not a budget. The phrase reads oddly, although the reader can still work out what is meant.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing would mislead a learner. The sample-complexity claims, the median-of-means steps and the postselection logic all match the English. The problem is terminology that shifts partway through the page. "Shadow tomography" is التصوير الظلي through [43] (where it is also misspelled تصويرًا ظلليًا), then becomes توموغرافيا الظل in [72], [75] and [86]. In the same later section, circuit changes from دائرة to دارة, spacetime codes from الشفرات الزمكانية to رموز الزمكان, and observables from المرصودات to القيم/المقادير المرصودة. Shots and statevector fall back to English there, even though لقطة and متجه الحالة were used earlier. Quantum state tomography in [11] is rendered التصوير الشعاعي, which means radiographic imaging.

examples.source: The shot scaling of shadow tomography is assessed by plotting the mean error...
examples.translation: ونقيّم تدرّج الـ shots في توموغرافيا الظل برسم متوسط الخطأ
examples.suggested: ونقيّم تدرّج عدد اللقطات في التصوير الظلي برسم متوسط الخطأ
examples.why: Entries [0]-[43] use التصوير الظلي for shadow tomography and لقطة for shot. This entry switches to توموغرافيا الظل and the English word shots.

examples.source: This tutorial performs local Pauli shadow tomography
examples.translation: يجري هذا الدرس تصويرًا ظلليًا بمؤثرات باولي المحلية
examples.suggested: يجري هذا الدرس تصويرًا ظليًا بمؤثرات باولي المحلية
examples.why: ظلليًا is a misspelling of ظليًا.

examples.source: Quantum state tomography
examples.translation: التصوير الشعاعي للحالة الكمية (Quantum state tomography)
examples.suggested: التصوير المقطعي للحالة الكمية (Quantum state tomography)
examples.why: التصوير الشعاعي means radiography or X-ray imaging. The Arabic sense of tomography is مقطعي, and the rest of the page never uses شعاعي.

examples.source: recovers the correct observables on a noiseless statevector ... across the deep GHZ circuit
examples.translation: تستعيد القيم المرصودة الصحيحة على statevector خالٍ من الضوضاء ... عبر دارة GHZ العميقة
examples.suggested: تستعيد المرصودات الصحيحة على متجه حالة خالٍ من الضوضاء ... عبر دائرة GHZ العميقة
examples.why: Earlier entries use المرصودات, متجه الحالة and دائرة. From here on the page switches to القيم المرصودة, the English statevector and دارة.

examples.source: low-overhead error detection with spacetime codes
examples.translation: كشف الأخطاء منخفض الكلفة بواسطة رموز الزمكان
examples.suggested: كشف الأخطاء بحمل إضافي منخفض باستخدام الشفرات الزمكانية
examples.why: Entries [8] and [12] use الشفرات الزمكانية and حمل إضافي منخفض for these terms. This entry switches to different wording for both.

editor_note: I found no meaning errors in the 86 rewritten entries. The numbers (1137 of 10000 shots, 49 of 120 determinants, the 0.1373 Ha gap), the caveats in entries 168-170 and the C++/Python comparison table all match the English. The problems are terminology. Entry 71 renders "transpiling" as ترجمة and "backend" as النظام الخلفي. The later C++ entries (134, 138, 164) use التحويل (transpile) and الـ Backend instead, and ترجمة also means "compile" in 109. Spin is لف in 122, 136 and 143 but مغزلي in 43. Symmetry is تماثل in 143 and 163 but تناظر in 43. "Convergence tolerance" became تفاوت التقارب, which reads as "convergence disparity".

examples.source: followed by transpiling our circuit for the backend of choice
examples.translation: ثم ترجمة دارّاتنا للنظام الخلفي المختار
examples.suggested: ثم تحويل (transpile) دارّاتنا للـ Backend المختار
examples.why: Entries 134, 138 and 164 use التحويل (transpilation) and الـ Backend, and ترجمة is also used for 'compile' in entry 109. Using the same word for both makes transpile and compile ambiguous.

examples.source: twice the number of orbitals (spin-up and spin-down)
examples.translation: ضعف عدد المدارات (لف علوي ولف سفلي)
examples.suggested: ضعف عدد المدارات (مغزل علوي ومغزل سفلي)
examples.why: Spin is مغزلي in entry 43 (مدارات مغزلية, حالة مفردة مغزلية) but لف in 122, 136 and 143. The page should use one rendering.

examples.source: converts them to Configuration Interaction (CI) strings using spin symmetrization
examples.translation: باستخدام تماثل اللف
examples.suggested: باستخدام تنظير المغزل (spin symmetrization)
examples.why: Symmetry is تناظر in entry 43 but تماثل here and in 163. Also, 'symmetrization' is a procedure, and تماثل names only the property.

examples.source: `--tolerance 1e-8`: Convergence tolerance for energy
examples.translation: تفاوت التقارب للطاقة
examples.suggested: سماحية التقارب للطاقة
examples.why: تفاوت means disparity or variation. The numerical-methods term for a tolerance threshold is سماحية (or حد التسامح).

editor_note: The meaning is accurate throughout, including the step-size trade-off in [63]/[67] and the bond-dimension reference caveat in [64]. Entries [0]–[31] are in Modern Standard Arabic, but from [33] on the prose switches to colloquial Gulf dialect: كمان, ترجّع, اللي, الحين, نقدر, لين, هذي, نشوف, ما يتلاشى. That does not fit technical documentation and is inconsistent with the first half of the page. Proper names and terms also split at the same point: Ising/إيزينغ, Trotter/تروتر, Néel/نيل, and "expectation values" as القيم المتوقعة in [6]/[13] but قيم التوقع in [40]/[56].

examples.source: We also define the following utility function, which returns the value of the bit
examples.translation: نعرّف كمان دالة مساعدة ترجّع قيمة البت
examples.suggested: نعرّف أيضًا دالة مساعدة تُرجع قيمة البت
examples.why: Colloquial Gulf dialect (كمان, ترجّع) in the middle of a page that is otherwise MSA. The same dialect continues through the second half (الحين, نقدر, اللي, هذي).

examples.source: will block until the job is completed

examples.suggested: تبقى محجوبة (تنتظر) حتى تكتمل المهمة
examples.why: لين is the dialect form of حتى. It reads as informal speech, not technical writing.

examples.source: described by the transverse-field Ising model above ... Trotter step size
